links.outcome: ChatGPT diagnostic performance compared with radiologist diagnoses for intracranial hemorrhage on NCCT
links.effect: Sensitivity 89.9%, specificity 84.8%, accuracy 87.3%; kappa 0.75 with radiologists; McNemar p = 0.31, no significant difference. Subtype sensitivity was lower for subdural (61.5%) and epidural (66.7%).
links.quote: McNemar's test showed no statistically significant difference between ChatGPT and radiologist diagnoses (p = 0.31).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of ChatGPT's diagnostic performance in detecting intracranial hemorrhage on NCCT brain scans compared to radiologist reports without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
